item.title: Sextortion: Two charged with offences against Nottingham student
item.description: Nottinghamshire Police have arrested and charged two men with blackmailing offences linked to sextortion. Sextortion is when criminals pose as someone else online, usually as a young female, and befriend young males online. item.title: Fire-damaged farm shop could become new homes
item.description: A former farm shop damaged by a fire could be redeveloped into new homes after plans were submitted to the council. The former Gonalston Farm shop site, which closed in 2022, could be redeveloped into three homes and garages after proposals were submitted to Newark and Sherwood District Council on Tuesday (January 6). item.description: Nottinghamshire Police is advising drivers to take extra care on Nottinghamshire’s roads today due to the icy conditions.
